turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.
I can help with that. Please send me your order number (like SC-1234) and the email the order was placed with, plus the new delivery address.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.

Thank you, Nora. Order SC-3360 has already shipped, and the address can only be changed before shipping. I can't file this change myself. I've passed your request, with the new address Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu, to a colleague. They will take over and decide what is possible.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Verified customer Nora Blake (nora.blake@example.com) asks to change delivery address on SC-3360 to Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu. Order already shipped (current address Str. Exemplu 8, Timisoara), so policy does not allow an automatic change. Staff must decide.
